cues.label: the film starts
cues.note: Zero, because a film has to begin at frame 0: the timeline must cover the whole duration, and a gap at the head renders as a marked black frame. This example ships without audio, so every cue here is authored rather than measured — `source: manual` says so honestly instead of claiming an analysis that never ran.

cues.label: the grid arrives
cues.note: Bar 1 of a 120 BPM grid starting at 0.4907 s. Written as a number because this example has no analysis/audio.json; in a real project this would be `b(1,0)` and the music would decide the instant.

cues.label: the chorus lands
cues.note: The loudest moment in the notional track. A real project would settle this with `cvpw cues` onto a measured impact rather than typing it.

cues.label: the burst has settled
cues.note: Deliberately equal to `settle`: the cut and the hold are one event here.

cues.label: the last image holds
cues.note: The last two seconds hold one image, which is the template's argument that a film should end on a decision rather than on a fade.
